description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of different model variants on three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—measured in percentage. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays four distinct configurations: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," ranges from 58 to 66, representing the performance values. The legend indicates that the purple line with circular markers represents Precision, the blue line with circular markers represents Recall, and the brown line with circular markers represents the F1-score. The "Full model (Ours)" variant achieves the highest scores for all three metrics, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. The "w/o Prompt" variant shows a significant drop in all metrics, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a moderate drop, with Precision at 62.22%, Recall at 62.63%, and F1-score at 63.75%. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant has the lowest scores, with Precision at 64.06%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%. The plot demonstrates that both prompt and augmentation are critical components for achieving high performance in the model.
